snippet_primary:
> "Stripe supports all major debit and credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and more. This also includes a wide range of local and alternative payment methods, such as:
> * Digital wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Samsung Pay, Cash App Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay
> * Bank redirects / transfers: iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Przelewy24, BLIK, FPX, Pay by Bank, Multibanco, MB WAY, OXXO, Konbini
> * Real-time payments: Pix, Swish, PayNow, PromptPay, PayTo
> * Mobile payments: TWINT, Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, PAYCO, MobilePay, Satispay, Revolut Pay
> * Buy Now, Pay Later: Afterpay / Clearpay, Klarna, Affirm, Alma, Zip, Billie"
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/65-connecting-your-stripe-account, Feb 25, 2026) states Stripe supports all major debit/credit cards plus 30+ alternative payment methods across 5 categories: digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Samsung Pay, Cash App Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay), bank redirects/transfers (iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Przelewy24, BLIK, FPX, Pay by Bank, Multibanco, MB WAY, OXXO, Konbini), real-time payments (Pix, Swish, PayNow, PromptPay, PayTo), mobile payments (TWINT, Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, PAYCO, MobilePay, Satispay, Revolut Pay), and BNPL (Afterpay/Clearpay, Klarna, Affirm, Alma, Zip, Billie)
metric_value_raw: 5 alternative payment method categories; 30+ specific methods listed
